channel.title: RouteTracker official blog
channel.description: RouteTracker how-to and product engineering notes

item.title: How to compare speed and pace on a repeated cycling or running route
item.description: Learn how RouteTracker compares a current cycling or running record with a similar previous route using split speed or pace and growth charts, including the Pro boundary and the limits of GPS-based comparison.

item.title: The full GPX import, follow, record, and export workflow
item.description: How to inspect an external GPX route in RouteTracker, record the real activity while following it, and export the completed activity as a new GPX file.

item.title: Seven checks before your first hike, ride, or run recording
item.description: A step-by-step RouteTracker checklist for location permission, GPS conditions, a short test recording, normal completion, recap review, and GPX export.

item.title: Why RouteTracker separates device-first records from Google Drive backup
item.description: How RouteTracker keeps core activity records on device by default and uses user-approved Google Drive snapshots only when Plus or Pro users choose backup, including restore limits.
